target_customer: Software and consumer companies that want to be recommended by AI assistants and coding agents (customer logos include Supabase, PostHog, Airtable, Clerk)
problem: Buyers and developers increasingly ask AI assistants and coding agents which tools to use. Companies cannot see how they appear in those answers or why agents pick rivals.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free tier and open-source CLI; separate plans for AI visibility and agent testing
product_category: AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) and agent-led growth platform

founders.name: Caelean Barnes
founders.background_notes: No background found on YC page or YC launch post.

founders.name: Evan Doyle
founders.background_notes: No background found on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Querying many AI engines at scale, parsing citations and running coding agents against products is standard engineering with some novel parts, such as agent experience testing.

defensibility.rationale: Monitoring prompts across AI engines is copyable, and many funded rivals appeared; accumulated prompt data and integrations give modest lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Many GEO startups raised seed rounds in 2025 and 2026 per press.

market_need_then: Search behavior shifting to AI assistants created demand to track brand visibility there. Dated evidence near September 2024 specific to Gauge was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product focused; coins the term Agent-Led Growth

branding.community_and_virality: Customer case metrics on the site (PostHog 41x LLM-referred traffic); no evidence of merch or fans.

brand_strength.rationale: A common word shared by many companies, so search is crowded; the ALG framing and logo wall help but evidence of brand-driven growth is thin.

pivots.from: AI visibility tracking and marketing agent for organic, paid and AI search
pivots.to: Agent-Led Growth platform covering visibility, agent preference and agent experience
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the YC launch post versus the current website. Date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Gauge joined YC in Summer 2024 as a small team selling AI visibility tooling and has expanded toward testing how coding agents pick tools. Its site lists well known developer companies as customers. Funding beyond an aggregator reported pre-seed is not confirmed and the company is active, so the outcome remains open in a crowded category.
notes: VCBacked reports a 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund dated September 2024, and Scrunch lists pre-seed undisclosed; both aggregators, unverified, so no round recorded. Competitor list empty: Profound is said by a 2026 comparison page to have launched in 2024, but no source dated near the batch was found. Team size 4 to 5 per YC. Pivot inferred.
